comparison.objective: Candidate transfers a machined workpiece using a removable lifting pin; record fills and assembles a moka pot for brewing.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires pin locking, shackle load control, fixture seating, and pin recovery; record requires controlled pouring, basket placement, thread alignment, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retention, lift height, three-point support, safe extraction, and release clearance; record grades water volume, basket presence, snug threading, spill limits, and release.
comparison.reason: Neither the manipulated mechanism nor the functional end state is equivalent; all spec versions provide sufficient rubric detail.
